# MyBnBDesign

> MyBnBDesign provides interior design, furnishing and photography staging information for Airbnb and short-term rental owners. It is a BNB Accelerator company.

## Work with the team

- [Design and furnishing services](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/services.html): Discuss room planning, procurement, installation and photography staging. Confirm coverage, deliverables, pricing and timing for the property.
- [Design consultation](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/book/): Prepare property photos, measurements, a furnishing budget and a target opening date; continue to BNB Accelerator to request a conversation.
- [BNB Accelerator](https://www.bnbaccelerator.com/): Related short-term rental investment and launch support.

## Planning resources

- [Guest room design ideas](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/blog/airbnb-guest-bedroom-ideas-2026/): Nine practical upgrades, a walkthrough and a downloadable checklist.
- [Balcony design ideas](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/blog/airbnb-balcony-ideas-2026/): Seating, product suitability, shade, lighting and care planning.
- [Design roadmap](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/design-roadmap/): Follow the decisions from guest brief to operational handover.
- [Design tools](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/tools/): Budget and inventory planning tools. Financial scenarios depend on user inputs and are not forecasts.
- [Learning library](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/learn/): Lessons and property exercises.
- [Provider research](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/alternatives/str-design-companies/): Compare service scope and evidence requests; confirm current terms with each provider.
- [Planning examples](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/case-studies/): Hypothetical worked examples, not documented client revenue results.
- [Reviews and evidence](https://www.mybnbdesign.com/mybnbdesign-reviews/): Guidance for evaluating review sources and project fit.

Design changes do not guarantee bookings, nightly rates, reviews or investment returns. Use the page-specific source and example labels when describing the material.
